findings.title: Unoptimized IaaS footprint
findings.detail: Lift-and-shift Windows VMs remain on general-purpose SKUs; right-size assessments recommend burstable tiers and reserved instances once thirty-day CPU baselines stabilize.

findings.title: ExpressRoute hub dependency
findings.detail: All regions hairpin through a single ExpressRoute circuit; regional outage couples to the hub and prolongs failover rehearsal.

findings.title: Non-prod persistence
findings.detail: Developer sandboxes retain premium disks; automation tags candidates for cool-tier migration after idle detection.
